title: There are these four kinds of persons, bhikkhus, appearing in the world. What four? Here, bhikkhus, a person does not respect virtue, does not regard…
content: There are these four kinds of persons, bhikkhus, appearing in the world. What four? Here, bhikkhus, a person does not respect virtue, does not regard virtue as supreme; does not respect concentration, does not regard concentration as supreme; does not respect wisdom, does not regard wisdom as supreme. Here, bhikkhus, a person respects virtue, regards virtue as supreme; but does not respect concentration, does not regard concentration as supreme; does not respect wisdom, does not regard wisdom as supreme. Here, bhikkhus, a person respects virtue, regards virtue as supreme; respects concentration, regards concentration as supreme; but does not respect wisdom, does not regard wisdom as supreme. Here, bhikkhus, a person respects virtue, regards virtue as supreme; respects concentration, regards concentration as supreme; respects wisdom, regards wisdom as supreme. These four kinds of persons, bhikkhus, appear in the world.

title: There are these five dangers, bhikkhus, for a person without serene confidence. What five? He reproaches himself; after consideration, the wise reproach him; a bad…
content: There are these five dangers, bhikkhus, for a person without serene confidence. What five? He reproaches himself; after consideration, the wise reproach him; a bad reputation spreads about him; at the time of death his mind is confused; after death, with the breakup of the body, he is reborn in a plane of misery, a bad destination, a lower realm, hell. Bhikkhus, these are the five dangers for a person without serene confidence. There are these five benefits, bhikkhus, for a person with serene confidence. What five? He does not reproach himself; after consideration, the wise praise him; a good reputation spreads about him; at the time of death his mind is not confused; after death, with the breakup of the body, he is reborn in a good destination, a heavenly world. Bhikkhus, these are the five benefits for a person with serene confidence.

title: Having known all abodes, not longing for any, That sage is truly a sage, without greed, without clinging, No longer striving, having reached the far…
content:
Having known all abodes, not longing for any,
That sage is truly a sage, without greed, without clinging,
No longer striving, having reached the far shore.

All-conquering, all-knowing, of perfect wisdom,
Undefiled regarding all things, abandoning all,
With craving destroyed, liberated —
The wise know that one as a sage.

Endowed with the power of wisdom, virtuous, observant,
Calm, delighting in jhāna, mindful,
Freed from all bonds, without taints —
The wise know that one as a sage.

title: Sāriputta, you should train yourselves thus: 'We will have peaceful faculties, peaceful minds.' Sāriputta, you should train thus. For those with peaceful faculties, Sāriputta, and…
content: Sāriputta, you should train yourselves thus: 'We will have peaceful faculties, peaceful minds.' Sāriputta, you should train thus. For those with peaceful faculties, Sāriputta, and peaceful minds, their bodily action will also be peaceful, verbal action peaceful, mental action peaceful. 'We will offer a peaceful gift to our fellow celibates.' Thus, Sāriputta, you should train yourselves.

title: Dhāniya: No gadflies or mosquitoes are found here, The cattle roam on the grassy meadow, They can endure the rain when it comes. So if…
content:
Dhāniya:
No gadflies or mosquitoes are found here,
The cattle roam on the grassy meadow,
They can endure the rain when it comes.
So if you wish, O deva of rain, let it rain!

The Blessed One:
A raft is well made, firmly bound together,
Having crossed to the far shore, having overcome the flood,
There is no further need for a raft.
So if you wish, O deva of rain, let it rain!

title: Walking and standing with self-control, Sitting and lying down with self-control, The bhikkhu, self-controlled, When bending and stretching his limbs. Above, across, and all around,…
content:
Walking and standing with self-control,
Sitting and lying down with self-control,
The bhikkhu, self-controlled,
When bending and stretching his limbs.
Above, across, and all around,
As far as the end of the world,
Regarding whatever kind of existence,
In this world,
He well observes the arising and passing
Of all aggregates.
With mind peaceful, in right conduct,
Constantly training,
Continuously, diligently,
The bhikkhu is so called.

title: Elder Paripuṇṇaka: Though one may enjoy food with a hundred flavors like nectar, It cannot compare with the meal I have today. This is the…
content:
Elder Paripuṇṇaka:

Though one may enjoy food with a hundred flavors like nectar,
It cannot compare with the meal I have today.
This is the wonderful Dhamma taught to me
By Gotama Buddha, the one of limitless vision.

title: When the field is complete, The seed is sown complete, When the rain falls complete, The harvest is complete, When no calamity is present, Growth…
content:
When the field is complete,
The seed is sown complete,
When the rain falls complete,
The harvest is complete,
When no calamity is present,
Growth is complete,
Expansion is complete,
The result is complete.
So too, giving
Among those of complete virtue,
And the gift material
Is also completely obtained,
It leads to completeness
Because of complete conduct.
Therefore, whoever wishes completeness
Must themselves be complete,
Serving those of complete wisdom,
Thus success is complete.
Complete in wisdom and virtue,
With mind complete,
Doing deeds complete,
Benefit is complete.
Knowing the world as it really is,
One attains complete view.
The complete path leads to
Attaining complete intention.
Abandoning all defilements,
One attains complete Nibbāna.
Liberated from all suffering,
That is complete perfection.

title: There are these two kinds of pleasure, bhikkhus. What two? Material pleasure and non-material pleasure. These, bhikkhus, are the two kinds of pleasure. The foremost…
content: There are these two kinds of pleasure, bhikkhus. What two? Material pleasure and non-material pleasure. These, bhikkhus, are the two kinds of pleasure. The foremost among these two kinds of pleasure, bhikkhus, is non-material pleasure.

title: These ten things, bhikkhus, are pure, bright, exist only in the Discipline of the Well-Gone One. What ten? Right view, right intention, right speech, right…
content: These ten things, bhikkhus, are pure, bright, exist only in the Discipline of the Well-Gone One. What ten? Right view, right intention, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, right concentration, right knowledge, right liberation. These ten things, bhikkhus, are pure, bright, exist only in the Discipline of the Well-Gone One.
